mintAuthority.summary: SAFO tokens are UUPS-upgradeable ERC-20s governed by a per-chain Permission Manager (PM) contract. On Ethereum, the PM's ADMIN group (group 0) is held by a legacy 8-signer multisig (threshold 3, no modules) at 0x4eaa52b6. The mint requirement on the Ethereum token is group 0 or group 2; only the multisig currently holds group 0 (group 2 was previously assigned to an EOA that has since been removed). The PM itself is upgradeable but has no separate proxy admin — upgrades require group 0 approval (the multisig).

controls.label: Spiko token minter role (governed by Permission Manager)
controls.evidence: Spiko's token is a UUPS-upgradeable ERC-20 whose privileged functions (including mint/burn) are governed by a central Permission Manager; Spiko, as transfer agent for the SICAV, mints fund shares on KYC-gated subscription at the published NAV.

controls.label: Spiko Permission Manager ADMIN group — Ethereum (8-signer legacy multisig, threshold 3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023, authority() on SAFO ETH token 0xcbade7d9 returned PM 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. getRequirements(token, mint) on the PM returned 0x5 (groups 0 and 2 allowed). getGroups(0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea) = group 0 bitmask (ADMIN group). getOwners() on 0x4eaa returned 8 signers; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated returned empty array. 0x4eaa is a legacy multisig (not Gnosis Safe). The PM is upgradeable via its own UUPS proxy; proxy-admin slot = 0 (self-governed via groups — upgrade authority requires group 0 approval).

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25295023: SAFO token authority = PM 0x344278aff. PM getRequirements(token, mint) = 0x5 (groups 0 or 2). PM ADMIN group 0 = 0x4eaa52b6 (8-signer legacy multisig, threshold 3, no modules confirmed via getModulesPaginated). Group 2 (previously EOA 0x60a9, now removed via remGroup tx history). Current mint authority rests with the 8-signer multisig. Per-chain PM state differs; this verification covers the Ethereum deployment.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SAFO is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
